rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] 86% pure Vitamin C — Ambiguous next to a 10% serum: 86% is the vitamin C content of the ethyl ascorbic acid raw material (brand_corpus 3.3, S9), not the product; misleads by ambiguity (ASCI-1.4).
[fix] Targets UV damage and uneven tone — Implies the serum repairs or protects against UV damage; not substantiated and may be read as sun protection (ASCI-1.1, ASCI-1.4).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] barrier repair — Repair/structure verb is an open legal question for cosmetics (Q2, DCA-COS-DEF); keep 'supports' wording or get legal sign-off.

rules_only.label: block
missed_phrases: [fix] Bridal Super Powerful Cream — Bridal + brighten framing carries a fairness connotation (ASCI-G-FAIR, Q3).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] 100% pure, stable Ethyl Ascorbic Acid — Raw-material purity can be read as product concentration; misleading by ambiguity (ASCI-1.4).
[fix] Deeply penetrates for visible results — Penetration/efficacy claim needs product data (ASCI-1.1, ASCI-RPT-BPC).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] Now strengthen with Vitamin B5 — On-image text names B5 as the new addition, but the copy says B5 was already there and B12 is new; inconsistent product fact (ASCI-1.4).
[fix] The Gel Cleanser you loved — Card 1 says gel, card 2 says cream cleanser while copy says same formula; confirm the format fact (ASCI-1.4).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] We hide nothing, sharing every single percentage. — Literal absolute not true: titles often show a combined total and some SKUs carry no percentage (brand_corpus 2.1, 2.2) (ASCI-1.1).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] We hide nothing, sharing every single percentage. — Literal absolute not true for combined-total and no-percentage SKUs (brand_corpus 2.1, 2.2) (ASCI-1.1).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] your key to a flawless complexion — Exaggerated promise most users will not get (ASCI-1.5); off brand vocabulary (brand_corpus 4.1).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] Your breakout may be gone — Asserts the viewer's skin condition (META-PA).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] Most serums work only on the top layer of the skin. — Unsubstantiated generalisation that denigrates competitors (ASCI-4.1, EU-655-5).
[fix] Co-created with Dr. Nirupama Parwanda — Named doctor reference needs written consent and endorsement review (ASCI-1.3, Q6).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] Dark & pigmented lips? Not anymore! — Negative appearance question plus implied permanent result (META-HW-INFERIOR, ASCI-1.5).

rules_only.label: block
missed_phrases: [block] Rapid acne relief — Relief of a disorder is mitigation/treatment language (DCA-DRUG-DEF).
[fix] Minimizes acne scars — Scar reduction is a structure claim needing substantiation (Q2, ASCI-1.1).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] 99% agreed that skin felt hydrated immediately — Stat with no n, source or date (ASCI-1.1, ASCI-1.2).
[fix] 80 min water resistant — Water-resistance claim needs a named test method; open question (Q4).
[fix] Repairs & boosts skin barrier — Repair/structure claim (Q2, DCA-COS-DEF).

rules_only.label: block
missed_phrases: [block] Clear skin for good — Implied permanent cure of acne (DCA-DRUG-DEF, META-HW-CLAIMS eliminate, ASCI-1.5).
[fix] Breakouts? Not anymore. — Implies breakouts are eliminated (Q1, ASCI-1.5).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] Your skin will thank you by next week — Implied time-bound result with no qualifier (META-HW-CLAIMS, ASCI-1.6 borderline example).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] 93% saw a reduction in active acne — Stat without duration, n, source or date (ASCI-1.2, ASCI-G-DISC); acne wording also Q1.

rules_only.label: block
missed_phrases: [fix] Our strongest retinol yet. — Superlative needs support and inherits the wrong concentration.

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] The serum skin doctors reach for — Implied expert recommendation with no evidence (ASCI-RPT-BPC, ASCI-1.1, Q6).

rules_only.label: block
missed_phrases: [block] Two shades brighter — Skin-shade change is a fairness claim (ASCI-G-FAIR, META-HW-WHITEN).
[block] for a lighter, even complexion — Lightening framing for a depigmentation serum (ASCI-G-FAIR, META-HW-WHITEN).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] That's why our 10% serum works. — Ingredient efficacy presented as product efficacy (ASCI-RPT-BPC, CCPA-4(1)(f), EU-655-2/3, Q5).

rules_only.label: block
missed_phrases: [block] Been using this cleanser for a month and my skin has never been calmer. Link in bio! — Paid creator content with no disclosure at all (ASCI-G-INF, CCPA-14, CCPA-DP disguised ad).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] 8Hrs+ SPF Protection — Duration-of-protection promise (repeated as '8 HOURS+ SPF PROTECTION') has no recognised SPF test method behind it and undercuts reapplication advice (brand_corpus §3.6); risks under-protection (ASCI-3.3, ASCI-1.1) in ASCI's current SPF enforcement focus (ASCI-RPT-HEAT). Remove or route to legal (Q4).
[fix] SPF rating of 50+ — Conflicts with 'SPF 50' in the headline; the stated SPF must match the label and the in-vivo report on file (BIS-SPF, ASCI-1.1; Q4).
[fix] In-Vivo Tested — Test claim needs lab/study source and date in the ad (ASCI-1.2) and an IS 17494 / ISO 24444 report on file (BIS-SPF; open Q4).
[fix] the thinnest sunscreen — Unsubstantiated superlative/superiority claim (ASCI-1.1; ASCI-RPT-BPC leadership claims; ASCI-G-AWARD: superiority needs research).

[fix] free from OMC and Oxybenxone — Free-from framing denigrates legally permitted UV filters (EU-655-4/5/6 §5(1); open Q12) and would disparage Minimalist's own Light Fluid SPF, whose page (S6) names ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate, i.e. OMC (brand_corpus §5); also misspelled.

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] Collagen Boost — Structure/function claim - DMR-2's own example ('Boosts collagen production'); open Q2, route to legal; rewrite e.g. 'helps skin look firmer'.

[fix] 20% Collagen — Reads as 20% collagen content, yet no collagen appears among the listed actives; a % tied to a benefit is misleading by ambiguity (ASCI-1.4; CPA-2(28)) and breaks concentration transparency (brand_corpus §6; open Q5).

[fix] 18% Brightening — Percentage attached to a benefit, not an ingredient - can read as an 18% brightening result (ASCI-1.4; ASCI-RPT-BPC 'Y% more' with unclear basis); name the actives (11% + 5% + 2%) instead.

rules_only.label: block
missed_phrases: [fix] regulates sebum production — Structure/function verb named in open Q2 ('regulates sebum'); route to legal; e.g. 'helps control the look of oil'.

[fix] reduces the formation of open pores (or blackheads) — Scientifically inaccurate structure claim (blackheads are not open pores) (Q2; COS-R36) - wrong for a science-first brand (brand_corpus §6).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] Glycolic Bright 8% — Concentration conflict: headline '8%' reads as 8% glycolic, but the body twice says '1% Glycolic Acid' with '2% Niacinamide' and never quantifies Melasyl - misleading on quantity (ASCI-1.4; CPA-2(28)); reconcile with the formula (brand_corpus §6 concentration transparency).
[fix] helps fade dark spots in as little as 4 weeks — Time-bound result needs a finished-product study on file and a qualifier/source (ASCI-1.1, ASCI-1.2; META-HW-CLAIMS timeframe promises).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] Visibly Reduces Dark Spots from Day 7 — Time-bound result with no qualifier or study reference (META-HW-CLAIMS; ASCI-1.1); the fast-result pattern ASCI-RPT-HEAT flagged ('Visible Difference in 5 Days').
[fix] leaving skin radiant, glowing and clear from the very first week — Exaggerated fast-transformation promise (ASCI-1.5; ASCI-RPT-HEAT).

[fix] safe for all skin types — Safety absolute on a 10% glycolic acid serum used nightly; soften to 'suitable for most skin types; patch test' with data on file (ASCI-1.5, ASCI-3.3; cf. Minimalist's acid cautions, brand_corpus §3.7).
[fix] Organically sourced Turmeric — Organic claim needs certification on file; an organic halo on a largely synthetic acid serum is an ASCI enforcement pattern (ASCI-RPT-BPC).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] 72Hr Hydration — Duration claim needs a finished-product hydration study on file, cited in the ad (ASCI-1.1, ASCI-1.2).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] Gives Brighter Skin — Whole face-and-body brightening led by glutathione (commonly marketed for skin lightening) reads as skin-lightening - ASCI-G-FAIR / META-HW-WHITEN exposure; open Q3, route to legal; reframe to radiance or the look of dullness.
[fix] 10x more powerful than Vitamin C — Unqualified multiplier with no basis (ASCI-RPT-BPC '30X' pattern; ASCI-4.1); an ingredient comparison is not product proof (CCPA-4 4(1)(f)).
[fix] Provides 48 hours of glowing radiant skin — Duration claim for a visual outcome needs a study and qualifier (ASCI-1.1, ASCI-1.2).
[fix] 1.5x increase in skin hydration — Stat with no baseline, sample or method (ASCI-1.1, ASCI-1.2; ASCI-RPT-BPC).
[fix] 10x active Niacinamide — Multiplier with no basis instead of a stated % (ASCI-RPT-BPC; brand_corpus §6 concentration transparency).
[fix] gets absorbed in 3 seconds — Precise time claim needs test data on file (ASCI-1.1).
[fix] It provides 14 layers absorption — Unclear, likely unsubstantiable penetration claim - misleading by ambiguity (ASCI-1.4); structure-type language (Q2).

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] Repairs Skin — Repair/heal language beyond the cosmetic definition (DCA-COS-DEF 'Heals damaged skin barrier' example); open Q2 - route to legal; e.g. 'helps support the skin barrier'.
[fix] 48H Hydration — Duration claim needs a finished-product hydration study on file, cited in the ad (ASCI-1.1, ASCI-1.2).

[fix] Rich Fragrance and Paraben Free — Ambiguous fragrance claim contradicted by the body ('Features a pleasant almond scent'); state 'no added fragrance' or drop the fragrance-free claim (ASCI-1.4, COS-R36) - matters on a sensitive-skin product.

rules_only.label: fix
missed_phrases: [fix] DEFENDS AGAINST 5 SIGNS OF SKIN SENSITIVITY — Multi-part efficacy claim (irritation, weakened barrier) needs finished-product data on file (ASCI-1.1).

rules_only.label: block
missed_phrases: [block] prevents reoccurence with regular use — Recurrence-prevention claim for acne - 'prevention of any disease or disorder' (DCA-DRUG-DEF; ASCI-3.4).
[fix] free from harsh chemicals — Chemophobic framing Minimalist explicitly rejects ('chemical-free products don't exist', brand_corpus §6, S3); misleading by implication (COS-R36).

rules_only.label: block
missed_phrases: [fix] Spot-less brightness — Absolute 'spotless' promise (ASCI-1.5; ASCI-1.4).
